title: fix(studio): a permission set's review link opens the draft review on its matrix page
body:
Fixes #37269

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到的变化：在软件包页点某个权限集草稿的链接，或在聊天里点「审阅 N 处改动」，打开权限集矩阵页时会弹出审阅面板，列出这份草稿相对已发布版本改了什么；Studio 的权限集页也一样，矩阵照常可以编辑。
- 为什么做：属于「Studio 重构」专题；以前这两个入口打开的矩阵页上看不到任何改动，审阅链接等于失效。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是审阅链接打开后面板不弹出或内容不对：权限集之外，其他类型的审阅也改走同一段共享代码（已有测试钉住，行为不变）；矩阵编辑不受影响。纯界面改动，直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

A review link (`?review=1`) on a permission-set draft now opens the draft review on the set's matrix page, the same review sheet the generic item page opens.

- **Shared presentation, not a second one.** The generic item page's review sheet (`ResourceEditPage`'s `Sheet` around `DraftReviewPanel`) moves into `DraftReviewSheet`, and its `?review=1` arrival effect into `useDraftReviewArrival` (read afresh, open once the read settles and a draft is pending, then drop `?review=1` with a history replace). `ResourceEditPage` now uses both; its behaviour is unchanged and its existing pins (`ResourceEditPage.detailTabs-36901`) pass on the shared hook.
- **The matrix honours `?review=1`.** `PermissionMatrixEditPage` uses the same hook and sheet. That covers Studio's `StudioPermissionSetPage` (which embeds the matrix, package leg) and the routed matrix on the cross-package leg, where both producers' links land (`/studio/~all/metadata/permission/NAME?review=1`, through Setup's metadata redirect).
  - At the arrival the matrix reads the pending draft and the published set on their own, at the matrix's layered address (`layeredPackageId`: the page's package, else the route's `?package=`), else by name alone, as the generic page reads a draft. The matrix's own load is not asked again, so an unsaved matrix edit is kept, and the matrix stays editable under the sheet and after it closes.
  - No pending draft: no review opens, and `?review=1` still leaves the address. No published set readable: no review (nothing to compare against).
  - Without `?review=1` the matrix reads exactly what it read before.
- **Address.** `?review=1` is dropped the way the generic page drops it; `AreaItemOpen` decides its page once per item (`StudioMetadataArea.tsx`), so dropping the query does not move the set off its matrix page. No routing changed.
- **Not changed:** the two producers (`PackagesPage.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx`), the flow and object review links, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx`, server, spec and routes. No locale key added.

Changeset: `.changeset/37269-permission-set-review-link.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, the new block above `const [draft, setDraft]`: the arrival's own draft and published read, and the sheet added to `dialogsEl`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/useDraftReviewArrival.ts`: the arrival effect moved out of `ResourceEditPage`; callbacks are read through a ref refreshed in an effect that runs before the arrival effect.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`: the inline effect and sheet replaced by the shared hook and component.

### Two-minute verification

On a showcase dev server, open Setup, then Packages, then a package with a pending permission-set draft, and click that draft's link. Expected: Studio opens the set's matrix with a right-hand sheet titled "Draft review" listing the changed keys, and the address no longer carries `review=1`.

## Tests

New pins, all at head of this branch:

- `StudioPermissionSetPage.fullScreen-36905.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` (the real Studio page and matrix):
  - `?review=1` shows the draft's change against the published set (only `label` differs), read at the page's package, then leaves the address;
  - editing stays: Escape closes the review onto the matrix, whose bulk buttons are enabled;
  - CONTROL: without `?review=1`, a set with a pending draft opens no review, and the matrix's load is the only draft read.
- `permissionReviewLinks-37269.test.tsx` (new; the real `PackageDetailSheet`, the real `StudioMetadataArea` on the cross-package leg, the real matrix registered as the type's `EditPage`):
  - the Packages page's per-draft link (href asserted, then clicked) reaches the matrix with the review shown, the matrix cells enabled, the draft read by name;
  - the chat's 「Review N change(s)」 (`setupMetadataStudioPath(item, 'review=1')`, as `DraftReviewNavigator` calls it) reaches the same;
  - CONTROL: the same page without `?review=1` opens no review and reads no draft;
  - a set with no pending draft opens no review, and `?review=1` still leaves the address.
- Unchanged and green: the flow and object review links (`StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561`), the generic page's review (`ResourceEditPage.detailTabs-36901`), the redirect tables (`setupMetadataRedirect`, `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`).

## Acceptance notes

- The matrix offers no chip to reopen the review once it is closed (the generic page has its header chip). The card asks for the arrival only; a reopen affordance on the matrix header would be a separate UX change.
- On the cross-package leg the matrix shows the published set (it has no package to read a draft at), while the review sheet shows the pending draft read by name. That is the matrix's existing behaviour on that leg; the sheet is what says what the draft changes.
- The arrival reads afresh at every `?review=1`, as the generic page does; unlike the generic page it does not reload the editor, so a same-item arrival keeps unsaved matrix edits.
